name: Hotel Minor
description: A homey, comfortable boutique hotel a short walk from Registan Square, popular for its accessibility and welcoming service.

name: Diyora Malika
description: A business-oriented hotel roughly 0.3 miles from Registan Square, offering a comfortable and efficient stay for both work and leisure travelers.

name: Silk Road by Minyoun
description: A luxury hotel with a full-service spa, indoor pool, sauna, and 24-hour fitness center, located a short drive from Shah-i-Zinda and Registan Square.

name: Zilol Baxt
description: A highly-rated luxury guesthouse in Samarkand known for its comfortable rooms and attentive hospitality.

name: Amin Guest House
description: A popular family-run guesthouse offering a cozy, traditional stay within easy reach of Samarkand's main historic sites.

name: Nursultan Boutique
description: A modern boutique-style hotel around 20 minutes' walk from Registan Square, known for its stylish rooms and notably good breakfast.

name: Vasiev's Hotel
description: A clean, well-located guesthouse close to shops and restaurants, popular with both solo travelers and families.

name: Movenpick Samarkand
description: A 5-star hotel offering a restaurant, bar, terrace, sauna, and hammam for a full luxury stay in Samarkand.
